description: DeepSeek-style autoregressive inference benchmark using HuggingFace LlamaForCausalLM with grouped-query attention (GQA). Generates tokens one at a time from a prompt. Reports tokens/sec throughput.

scaling_param.name: num_new_tokens
scaling_param.description: Number of new tokens to generate autoregressively

non_scaling_params.name: prompt_len
non_scaling_params.description: Length of the input prompt in tokens

non_scaling_params.name: num_key_value_heads
non_scaling_params.description: Number of key-value heads for grouped-query attention
